task: TASK R — read the grid, entry and lookup code of five open-source crossword construction tools; report R1-R6 per repo with file paths and line ranges, plus a comparison table.
mode: primary-source code reading (no web search); all corpora retrieved to disk and read in the main thread
assumptions: The user's output contract (SOURCES table schema, per-question findings, gaps section) supersedes the deep-research skill's report template (no Executive Summary / Recommendations sections). Explicit rule: 'No design recommendations for our system.'
'Retrieval status FETCHED' for a code source means the named files were read in full or the cited regions were read directly from the local clone.
Line ranges are pinned to the commit SHAs / tarball hash recorded below; they are unverifiable against any other revision.
exet delegates its grid and clue data structures to Exolve (same author, separate repo); Exolve is therefore added as a source rather than reported as 'not present' in exet.
Phil vendors a modified glucose-3.0 SAT solver that carries Phil's crossword-specific grid/entry/lookup code; it is reported under Phil with its own licence.

gate_evidence.scope: 206 rows: quote must occur verbatim inside its cited line range
gate_evidence.red_probe: wrong line range + mistyped quote, both rejected
gate_evidence.genuine_catch: E176 (two-line comment cited as one line); E192 (locator naming the wrong one of two similar functions)

gate_citations.scope: 469 qualified (path:N-M) + 72 bare (:N-M, resolved against the nearest preceding qualified path) citations in the report resolve to a real file with an in-bounds range
gate_citations.red_probe: out-of-bounds bare range, bare ref with no preceding path, and non-existent file; all rejected

corrections_during_run: The R5 absence claim ('where can this word go' is absent) was initially written flat; running the search it claimed surfaced ExolveGridInferrer in exolve/exolve-from-text.js, so the claim was scoped to the task's sense of the question and the inferrer reported separately.

Qxw R3 initially stated 'no per-entry ownership'. struct word.fe (common.h:217), derived per filler run at filler.c:1044-1047, exempts a constructor-completed entry from the dictionary constraint at filler.c:525. Section 5 R3, table 6.1 and gap 8.1 were amended.

gate_citations.py initially matched only qualified path:N-M citations, leaving 72 bare :N-M references in the report unguarded while reporting a full pass. The gate was extended to resolve bare refs against the nearest preceding qualified path, re-run red, then green.

validators_skipped.why: The deep-research validators check [N] markers against a numbered Bibliography. This report cites sources as [S1]-[S15] and code as path:line with no numbered bibliography, so validate_report/verify_citations would pass vacuously or fail on an unsupported format. The claim ledger is the note field of each evidence.jsonl row, checked by gate_evidence.py and gate_citations.py.
